reason: I cut hair myself in a one or two chair shop, I know every customer and every rupee, and my register has never failed me. Who is in which chair, attendance, cash drawer checks - I can see all that by turning my head; paying ₹999 a month plus ₹4,999 for that is money out of my own pocket for nothing new.
objection: When there are customers waiting, nobody, me included, is going to stop to take a selfie, type a number and make a bill in an English app. In two weeks we would be back to the register and I would still be paying every month.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked from just the UPI payments already coming to my phone, with no typing, and the WhatsApp reminders actually brought old customers back, at around ₹299 a month with no setup fee.
